Nina Patel: FYI QuiverHealth dedicated rollout is set for Thu 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (quiet window 02:30-04:30). Need final pin, canary plan, and explicit rollback gates.
Priya Rao: Product ok. Release notes posted: https://redwood.in/release/quiver-april2  lists toggles and tenant privacy steps.
Samir Choi: SRE: will run a focused staging soak tonight. Confirmed Quiver KMS rotation not colliding. Watch GPU mem and open file handles.
Jules: Can we get the exact deploybot invocation? I'll validate the canary slices and health-check hooks.
deploybot: deploybot: Job created
```
run-release --customer quiverhealth --target dedicated --runtime v1.12.4 --bundle quiver-rl-2026-03@sha256:7a9c --canary 5,25,100 --quiet-window 02:30-04:30 --rollback-on "err>1.5% OR p95>800ms for 2x5m" --notify-channel eng-releases
```
Theo Lang: Ops: capture these rollback thresholds in the job: error rate >1.5% OR p95 >800ms sustained for two consecutive 5m windows -> immediate rollback. Also alert on kv_cache_miss >3x baseline and token error surge >2x.
Marta Gonzalez: Product confirms feature flags default OFF for Quiver tenant. They will enable after post-rollout verification.
Samir Choi: Staging smoke run started  small GPU mem bump (~6%) with this model bundle vs previous, but within headroom. No FD leak seen.
Jules: I'll run eval harness at each canary step and post delta snapshots (fuzzy match + rouge). If eval drift >4% at any step we hold.
Nina Patel: Final approvals? @Samir @Theo @Marta @Priya
Samir Choi: +1 SRE. Staging soak green.
Theo Lang: +1 Ops. Watch KV miss metric.
Marta Gonzalez: +1 Prod.
Priya Rao: +1 Product owner.
deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled  will auto-start at 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z and stream events here. Dry-run checks passed.
Jules: On-call for canary validation. Will post results within 10m of each canary step.
Nina Patel: Great. I'll pin runtime and bundle in the release ticket and attach these rollback rules. Tag back here if anything changes. :)
